title: The title presets walk pulls Film Super off the video Library's short shelf again
goal: Since a video's Library opens as a short shelf, one walk tries to pull the Film Super title off it while that tile is half scrolled out of sight, so the walk fails although a person can still scroll to it and drag it. The walk should scroll to the tile first, the way a person would, and pass again.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-12 on HEAD bb0f48d7b: Scripts/playtest-all.sh comes-away title-presets-library-shelf -> title-presets-library-shelf-walk FAILED step 25 (pickUpTile): the tile "Film Super" is not all the way where a person could pull on it: it is at (1600, 312) (114, 106) and the window is (1728, 990). A `reveal` step scrolls the shelf until it is. The other three pick-up walks passed in the same run. Cause: 1db5bdff4 (A video's Library opened by hand is the mock's short shelf) capped the video shelf at header + 118pt, so its tiles scroll inside it. The walk passed at 05:02Z before that commit (a-walk-that-pulls-a-library-tile-by-hand-sees-it). Fix is most likely a {"do":"reveal",...} step before step 25; keep the short shelf, it is the mock.
acceptance: title-presets-library-shelf-walk passes at Next defaults, twice in a row
The walk brings Film Super fully into view before pulling it (a reveal step), rather than the shelf being made taller again
